of the intersection points in the order in which they occur along 𝐶 gives a sequence
spanning (−∞, +∞) turns each forest into a rooted ordered tree. These are the upper and lower
family trees used by both historical algorithms (Hoffmann et al. 1986, p. 173; Fung et al. 1990, p. 87).
